subject: Copywriting
title: Prebunking: Inoculating Against Lies
description: A micro-lesson that makes Prebunking: Inoculating Against Lies usable.

hook.text: Prebunking exposes people to weakened propaganda before they encounter the real thing.

buildup.text: Google's Jigsaw unit created short videos showing manipulation techniques.

discovery.text: Inoculation theory: expose people to a weak version of an argument, and they develop antibodies against the real thing.

twist.text: Prebunking works better than debunking. Once someone believes a lie, correcting it often strengthens the belief.

climax.text: Governments including the UK and EU now invest in prebunking campaigns.

punchline.text: Expose the trick first, and the propaganda fails. Prebunking works 21% better.

quiz.question: How much better at spotting fake news were viewers of Google's prebunking videos?
